about: Fixture set for the Discover themes prompt (themes-draft@2), from the fictional Riverside engagement. Each case has the inputs discover_theme_claim hands the worker, the reply recorded for the fake client, and what the themes may and may not contain. The recorded reply is checked against the expectations always.

cases.name: Riverside: five conversations and five cards

notes.text: We are warm on Sunday. Priya runs the welcome table and it is the best part. Newcomers cannot find a small group to join. The groups are full and nobody tells them the next step.
Our music and worship are a real strength. People stay for the singing. A few volunteers carry everything and they are burning out.
Visitors come once and we lose them. There is no clear first step. Volunteers are stretched thin, the same five people every week.
I feel alone as a leader. Nobody checks on the leaders. Small groups are hard to find for new families too.
Giving is steady and generous. The worship band is the heart of Sunday.

cards.text: The music and worship are strong
Hard to find a small group as a newcomer
The same few volunteers do everything
A clear next step for visitors
